note: Family-owned park on US-30 west of Missouri Valley, beside DeSoto National Wildlife Refuge and 30 minutes from downtown Omaha. Short, weekly and long-term stays; the operator also courts workers and extended stays. Formerly DeSoto RV Campground. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's site: $35 a night ($220 a week, monthly by phone), 15 back-in full-hookup 50-amp sites, Starlink Wi-Fi, phone booking. Gate: $35 posted (under $50); no gateway within 40 km; not stayed at. Presence: working website with phone (Google only 2 reviews). Long-stay tests all pass. Not waterfront confirmed (a lot on US-30 among fields). Pin fine.
flags: GOOGLE: 5.0 stars from 2 reviews (DeSoto Bend RV Resort, 1421 US-30; +1 402-990-2291). Reviews read: 'We needed a place to stay just one night on a three day drive home. We called a couple days ahead, and Eric was super accommodating. We arrived kind of late, but he was outside and got us to an easy spot...' (a month ago, owner replied); 'Great place' (4 months ago). RV Life (as Desoto R V Campground): 4 stars, $$, avg rate $31; no review count shown. No Campspot/Campendium/Dyrt rating with 25+ reviews found. Not a Good Sam Park (no stored discount).

LONG-STAY (pass, say so in the note): the operator advertises 'short visits, weekly stays, and long term guests' and 'Flexible options for travelers, workers, and extended stays'. (1) price $35/night, under $50, no gateway needed; (2) nightly rate on its own site plus phone; (3) no minimum stated; (4) no count of nightly vs monthly sites anywhere (passes); (5) an RV park of 15 sites, no homes or lots for sale. Recent review describes a one-night stay. Not borderline.
Presence: working website (c) 2026 with phone 402-990-2291 (matches Google); Google has only 2 reviews, so presence rests on the website.
